settings.heading: Prints
settings.standfirst: Editions of ten, printed in the studio.

settings.heading: FAQs
settings.note: Write if your question is not here.

settings.question: How are the prints made?
settings.answer: I print on archival cotton paper with pigment inks in the Gothenburg studio. Each print is checked before it is signed.

settings.question: What sizes are available?
settings.answer: The usual sizes are 30 × 40 cm and 40 × 50 cm. Ask about a particular photograph if you need another size.

settings.question: What does an edition of ten mean?
settings.answer: Ten numbered prints are made at each stated size, with two artist’s proofs. The edition is not extended.

settings.question: Do you ship outside Sweden?
settings.answer: Yes. Prints travel flat or rolled, depending on size. I confirm packing, shipping and any customs costs before payment.

settings.question: Can a print arrive framed?
settings.answer: Framing can be arranged in Sweden. Elsewhere I send the unframed print and the paper and mounting details for your framer.

settings.heading: Prints and editions
settings.text: Selected photographs are available as signed prints. Each is made in the studio, checked in daylight and numbered by hand.
settings.edition_note: Editions of ten. Signed and numbered.
